'''2018 World Championship''' was the Players Committee World Championship in Morristown, New Jersey, 4–7 October 2018. [[Bastian Winkelhaus]] finished 1st in Day 3. Sixty-nine constructed pairs were published for Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Morristown, New Jersey
* '''Dates:''' 4–7 October 2018
* '''Winner:''' [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]
